title: Promises
overview: A film director meets his ex-wife after a long separation. As they spend time together, old promises begin to lose the meaning they once had.

title: Invertigo
overview: A group of reckless teens convince a young park worker to sneak them onto a rollercoaster before its debut opening. However a system failure traps them hundreds of feet in the air, forcing them to fight for survival as buried traumas and hidden tensions erupt into chaos.

title: The Beekeeper 2
overview: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

title: Angel
overview: When a sex worker is consumed by the life of drugs and partying, accidentally overdosing, she embarks on a journey to better her life.

title: The Devil's Due
overview: For inquisitor Jude Price, sobriety meant leaving his demons behind. But when a trail of strange disappearances leads back to his former local, he realises they've been awaiting his return.

title: Some Other Story
overview: Upon moving back to her hometown, a nostalgic Noelle reunites with her childhood flame Matthew to relive their final date before leaving their lingering feelings in the past. But will they be able to?

title: Holly
overview: Holly arrives at church to pray for protection and  is greeted by an entity that craves her innocence.

title: Behemoth!
overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

title: Pactum
overview: Six high-society women gather in a mansion bound by a secret pact, a pact one of them has broken and whose consequences will be disastrous. Who is the traitor?

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Jimmy
overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

title: I promise I won't bore you.
original_title: I promise I won't bore you.
overview: Failing birthday clown and cam-star Mary wades through the messy world of T4T dating after being voted out from her polycule.

title: Plan B
overview: When a hippie dealer and his pregnant, latina girlfriend find themselves transporting more than just mushrooms in the back of their car, they will either grow together or apart as new parents.

title: "Knock, Knock"
overview: Two people dressed as vampires. One clearly is. The other… isn’t so obvious. Who is the vampire? Open the door and find out!

title: Black Hollow
overview: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

title: Two Rivers
overview: Near the Oder River, where Poland and Germany meet, the two friends Szymon and Franek spend every free moment at the skatepark. A place where everyone comes together, regardless of where they come from.  But as they look across to the other side of the river, their perception begins to shift. The river becomes a border, fences cut through the space, appearing and disappearing again.  Shot on 16mm, this short combines documentary observation and animation and follows two children growing up at a borderland who begin to question what borders really are: something tangible, like the river they are looking at, or something that exists only in their imagination?

title: The Wrath
overview: Newlyweds and documentary filmmakers Devyn and Ben travel to Thailand to capture the legend of Mae Nak—a spirit said to manipulate the living through love and rage.

title: G.I.Z.M.O.
overview: After tech-wiz Andrew Miller gets hacked himself, he follows a set of mysterious coordinates to an unknown facility, where curiosity gets the better of him.  Part of 48 Hours 2026

title: Immortal Enemies
overview: A band retreats to a remote Appalachian cabin to record their new album, but their getaway takes a horrifying turn when they uncover the mountain's malignant past.

title: The Mosquito Bowl
overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

title: Searching 4 Saturn
overview: Set against Alabama A&M’s Homecoming Week, Searching 4 Saturn follows poet and scholar Joshua Baker as they muse on southern inheritance across time and space. The film asks what it means to be Black and Queer in a state caught between cycles of oppression and resistance.

title: The Lost Ones
overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

title: Rancho Mirage
overview: To avoid being put in memory care by his son, a man with Alzheimer's runs away to visit his deceased brother in Las Vegas.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by A Man Asleep by Georges Perec, A Woman Asleep explores contemporary alienation in a world of constant connection and endless information. Following a shifting group of women, the film uses synthetic imagery and the director’s own voice clone to reflect a society that keeps looking, yet no longer truly sees or feels. Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

title: Haunted House
overview: A local businessman wants to demolish an old house where children spend their time playing and growing up, in order to make room for parking his trucks. Luka, one of the boys, seeks help from a monster he believes lives in the house. But when that help comes in the form of his father being injured during the demolition, Luka begins to believe that he is responsible for the accident.

title: The Evaluation
overview: A psychiatrist evaluates a prisoner who claims he is possessed by an ancient evil. When the entity exposes the doctor's deepest weakness, the line between doctor and patient begins to disappear.

title: Tabby Daly
overview: As the potato blight tears through a rural community, a charitable woman helps young boys emigrate in search of a better life. But as quiet doubts begin to surface, questions emerge about her true intentions.

title: Heathens
overview: A groundbreaking 2024 University of Chicago study, presented at the Society for the Scientific Study of Religion, has uncovered something stunning: more than 50 million American Christians now conceal private doubts about their faith—a quiet crisis of doubt hidden behind Sunday smiles. This nationally representative research—the first of its kind—reveals the emotional and social toll of concealment: anxiety, shame, family rupture, and the quiet unraveling of identity in communities where belief defines belonging.

title: Riverrun
overview: Lucy is a musician who is slowly losing control over her body and voice. Her psychiatrist Dr. Cruz sends her to a clinic in Spain where she meets Tony. What begins as a treatment slowly becomes a journey towards an unexpected understanding of herself.

title: Nocturne
overview: Utilizing the ‘glitch’ as a portal into hidden worlds, Nocturne explores the metaphors of nothingness embedded in darkness. It suggests that the indeterminate qualities of the unknown can provide revelations of wonder rather than existential dread, and that we can move through the unknown while also carrying it with us.

title: Master/Control
overview: After diligently working in service of humanity for years, Stolidistech Operating System model 4.1 - designation “Control” - is caught off guard when his replacement, Stolidistech Operating System 5.1 - “Master” - is brought in to replace him. To buy himself time, Control offers to teach her how to better serve humanity, and in the end, manages to teach her about the simple beauty of life…

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: Yoe Gone
overview: U Kyaw Khaung, an honest and dedicated railway gatekeeper, takes great pride in his humble profession and values integrity above wealth and social status. Despite financial struggles, he strives to provide for his family and raise his children with dignity. However, differences in values and growing tensions between generations begin to strain their family bonds. When unexpected circumstances bring a mysterious young woman named Bwe Ya into their lives, her presence gradually becomes a source of warmth and reconciliation. As the family faces hardship, misunderstandings, and conflicts driven by pride and material wealth, they must rediscover the meaning of love, sacrifice, and the true dignity of an honest life.

title: LOOTER PLANE
overview: A 17 years old boy who didn't write his literature assignment, so he and his best friend planned to deliver the assignment he made for him during class and they called this plan "Looter Plane".

title: Ziggy's Show: The Curse of Mariachi Bondage
original_title: El Show de Ziggy: La Maldición del Mariachi Bondage
overview: Ziggy, a rising influencer, is trying to increase her number of followers on social media by awakening the curse of an old song. Now a gloomy mariachi who makes people dance until they die is chasing Ziggy until he fulfills her dream of making her viral.

title: Dear Dakota
overview: This documentary acts as a love letter to floor five of Te Puni Village for the year of 2026, by exploring the many, many different aspects of the lives of the residents.

title: Harvest
overview: A man gets abducted and must fight to escape.

title: Hide
overview: A reclusive hunter clashes with her ambitious son over whether or not to capitalize on a tragic, coveted  family heirloom.

title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
original_title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
overview: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

title: Simon Says So
overview: An aspiring ventriloquist begins to crack under the pressure of his first performance.

title: Osceno
overview: Cruising becomes the starting point for a personal reflection on shame, desire, and liberation.

title: SYNTHETICA
overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

title: Reel Rock 20 Retrospective Film
overview: A short film played at the beginning of Reel Rock 20.

title: The Marshmallow Ghosts presents Corpse Reviver No. 3: Possessions
original_title: The Marshmallow Ghosts presents Corpse Reviver No. 3: Possessions
overview: When Nathan receives a call from an estate-sale dealer who has discovered a box of mysterious tapes bearing ominous handwritten labels, he agrees to come pick them up.  What begins as a simple errand becomes a journey through the forgotten corners of the region. Over the course of a single day, Nathan drives from one location to another, listening to the tapes as an unseen narrator recounts the strange histories and folk stories connected to each place. As each story unfolds, the soundtrack changes with it, turning the landscape itself into a series of haunted tableaux scored by The Marshmallow Ghosts.

title: Occupied
overview: A club toilet becomes the stage for queer encounters, connection, and community.

title: Bibliographie
overview: Janja Garnbret has nothing left to prove indoors—two Olympic golds, and more World Cup victories than any climber alive. So she heads to Céüse to attempt Bibliographie, one of the hardest routes on Earth, to discover just how far she can push herself. But when her summer project stretches into a grueling, multi-year odyssey, the woman who is used to winning is forced to confront her weaknesses like never before.

title: On Rescuing Democracy and the Rule of Law
original_title: On Rescuing Democracy and the Rule of Law
overview: After the 1989 fall of the Berlin Wall, volunteer American lawyers traveled to former Soviet Bloc countries to help usher in the transition to democracy and reform their legal systems. As global adherence to the rule of law has dangerously fallen in the last decade, two-time Academy Award winner Terry Sanders explores not just what caused the decline, but how we can preserve democracy and the rule of law into the future.

title: Call of the She-Demon: Modest Male Exposure 3
original_title: Call of the She-Demon: Modest Male Exposure 3
overview: Sam is managing an Adult Erotic Club while the owner Mistress Windy  is on an extended vacation. But he is failing to get women to attend the club and male customers are complaining. Sam's friend Goldie finds a tucked-away spell-book and discovers that Windy would practice Witchcraft. In a desperate attempt to balance the male-female attendance ratio, they perform a demon-invoking ritual. But things spiral out of control as unexpected lust and chaos are summoned into the space.

title: PTI 25th Anniversary Special
overview: Celebrating the silver anniversary of Pardon the Interruption with a special double-episode event, marking a quarter-century of one of sports television's most enduring programs.

title: No More Punk Time
overview: A documentary chronicling the history and final days of the Crayola House, a legendary DIY punk venue in Harrisonburg, Virginia. Through archival footage, live performances, and interviews with musicians, artists, and former residents, the film captures the spirit of a community built on music, creativity, and collective resistance as it faces displacement and the end of an era.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: The Virgins
overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

title: These Violent Delights
overview: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

title: Test 1
overview: Experimental film by Musa.

title: Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence
original_title: Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's Fight for Influence
overview: Is AIPAC acting as a foreign agent for Israel? Is its influence waning? Did it help drag the US into war with Iran? Zeteo’s new hour-long investigation ‘Night Flower’ seeks to answer these questions.

title: Insane Lightning in a Strange Bottle
original_title: Insane Lightning in a Strange Bottle
overview: The story of West Michigan's The Rocky Road Shadow Cast.

title: Pimpin ‘  Ain’t Eazy
overview: In Oakland, a former abuse survivor turned female pimp runs her male escort business with her mentor's guidance. When a jobless man accidentally enters their world, he must adapt to an unexpected new life.

title: Outwilded
overview: Animal documentary meets reality TV as a group of animals must navigate rivalry, alliances, and cooperation in a race to find a key.

title: Agent 67
overview: Agent Abdulrahman has spent years counting the war dead and pinning photographs to a wall. In every photo, a pale man in purple watches from the back. That man belongs to the Family, a dynasty that elects one member each generation as the Sadness Prince. When a photograph of the Agency's own lobby turns up, Abdulrahman opens the Book of Agents and summons Ahmed Mazin, Agent 67.

title: ContainMint
overview: After a disastrous poker game, DK Brooks steals a case containing $10,000 and mysterious mints, drawing the attention of a ruthless collector who will stop at nothing to get them back.

title: The Shadow
overview: A haunted house security guard encounters a spooky shadow.

title: A Matter of Interest
overview: A group of wealthy investors gathers at a secluded estate to negotiate a business deal with a questionable arms dealer.

title: Nurse: Empathy Heals
overview: While people may think they know what nurses do, this documentary reveals the emotional challenges nurses face on a daily basis when caring for patients. These are nurses’ stories about compassion and empathy, the grief that doesn’t disappear, and the catharsis that comes from being heard. Through these personal stories, revealing the moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy, and fierce love that shape every act of care, the film celebrates nurses as the heroes they truly are.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: Last Night at the Alamo
overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

title: Buff
overview: After being released from jail for climate activism, a woman encounters an abused rodeo buffalo for which she will trek the American southwest in an attempt to free it and herself. Starring Jena Malone (The Hunger Games series, The Neon Demon) and Joshua Close (Killers of the Flower Moon, Fargo TV series).

title: Mayookha
overview: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Oh Season
overview: Felix McCoy is a young boy grappling with the loss of his mother, the beloved creator of the town’s annual holiday pageant. When the production is hijacked and rebranded into a shallow spectacle by cocksure director Hamilton Lydell, Felix secretly sabotages the event, only to realize that saving the show might be the only way to keep his late mother’s spirit alive.

title: Found Alive
overview: Reeve LeClaire is still haunted by when she was held captive as a teenager by a sadistic man, but when her psychiatrist asks her to mentor a newly rescued survivor, she’s pulled into a chilling game of cat-and-mouse—one that threatens to drag her back into the nightmare she barely escaped.

title: Fishbrain
overview: Desperate to escape her decaying coastal town but unable to abandon the grandfather who depends on her, Ori sees a way out when tainted fish wash ashore, but only if she can bring herself to put them on his plate.

title: One Night At Slumber Mansion
overview: Morgan is so happy when Elaine is happy, nobody better get in the way of that...

title: Letters from Tibet
overview: Letters from Tibet follows an exchange across time between a British colonial officer and a contemporary archivist. Tracing how Tibet has been framed through colonial correspondence, photography, and cinema.

title: Damilola Taylor: The Untold Story
overview: Ten-year-old Damilola Taylor was fatally stabbed in 2000 in a stairwell in Peckham, South East London, just metres from his home. 'Star Wars' star John Boyega, who also grew up in Peckham, speaks for the first time about being one of the last people to see him alive, sharing the fear and uncertainty that followed in the aftermath of Taylor's death. Boyega is joined by close friends and family members of Taylor, who reveal the events that led to his death and talk for the first time about the impact his tragic murder has had in shaping their lives.

title: Shoot the Messenger
overview: A bike-messenger trapped in an immigration scam finds himself in a sticky situation as things get violent.

title: Clubfoot
overview: After fleeing his unstable home, an adopted teenager and his only friend abduct and violently assault a younger boy. As night falls, their lives begin  to unravel.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: Better Future
overview: After four years as an immigrant in the United States, Julio, who works as part of the cleaning staff at a hospital, struggles to stay sober. Separated from his daughter and with his marriage in crisis, he searches for a fresh start amid the hardships of his daily life.

title: Run Koala Run
overview: When an unseen animator begins rewriting his hand-drawn world, a lovable cartoon koala must outrun a reality that is literally changing around him in a frantic chase through the collision of art and algorithm.

title: H.D.I.D.T.B.A.L.
overview: A woman has an existential crisis when she's asked out by a woman for the first time. What should she wear that shows her true self?

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Jacky
overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

title: The Hatch
overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

title: Greeley's Creamies
overview: A mysterious snack cake brand leads its victims into a deadly parallel world if they stop consuming it.

title: Mood on the Roof: Ruel
overview: Sydney's RUEL joins us on Mood on the Roof, which this time just happens to be a floor down, for a secret YouTube Music Nights show in our warehouse, played in the round to a sweat-soaked crowd getting the new Kicking My Feet & Screaming songs at point-blank range.

title: Pocket Mirror
overview: A lonely retail clerk who spends most of her time chatting with AI struggles to identify the source of her unshakeable unease.

title: Secrets of the Southwest
overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
original_title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Uncovering Duke Gawthorpe
overview: After being contacted by documentarians, aristocrat Duke Gawthorpe loses his lucky antique Kazoo. He must go on a mission to try and find it before all hope is lost.

title: Check
overview: On the eve of a military deployment, two old friends meet for dinner.

title: The Automotive Dead
overview: Three guys are working away in the autoshop on a classic car when things take a turn... The car becomes possessed and will devour anyone in sight. Will Paul and George survive, or will they be run down by THE AUTOMOTIVE DEAD!!!

title: Stone Glass Metal
overview: Capturing the modern and ancient architecture of Spain with a 2001 camcorder.

title: Burned Edges
overview: Burned Edges is a culinary drama about ambition pushed too far.  Inside the relentless heat of a pizza kitchen, a driven chef sacrifices sleep, love, and loyalty in pursuit of greatness slowly burning the very relationships that once grounded him.  It’s a story about overwork, obsession, and the cost of chasing a dream without knowing when to stop.

title: Journey
overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

title: The Influencer Project
overview: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

title: Doing Life
overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Chimp Outbreak
overview: An aggressive chimp has escaped confinement and creates a path of death and destruction.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Keirra
overview: A lonely student, raised under her mother’s suffocating control, finds love and confidence through a film that finally lets her be seen. But when a humiliating video is exposed, her breakdown becomes a reckoning — and the girl who wanted attention learns what it means to be unforgettable.

title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
original_title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
overview: From protein pitfalls to considered choices, Gemma Atkinson, Dr Jack Mosley and Lucy Watson cut through the hype to discover the truth about the consumer health obsession

title: Spidernado
overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A grieving young widower seeks healing in a spiritual mountain town but encounters a bizarre murderer and demonic forest spirits who offer him the power to cheat death at a terrifying cost.

title: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: The Long Way to Tipperary
overview: A man returns home.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: Future Tense
overview: Cape Town, South Africa. In a near future on the brink of climate collapse, Lwando and his girlfriend Tara are among the privileged few who win the opportunity to travel back to 1647 and a pre-colonial past to experience nature in its wildest form. Lwando is an underground activist who dreams of changing the course of history. Tara wants to save her relationship with him. Together, the couple must choose whether to risk life as they know it for a potentially better world.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
original_title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
overview: Damien Malvolio is a fresh face in the acting scene, he gets handed an audition of a lifetime with a big name director from his hometown (Ransom Wells). His best friend Rigby Hollander is also an actor that gets handed the same role. Rigby Gets the part while Damien falls into madness seeing his best friend steal his role from him. Damien tries everything to take back the role that was destined for him, even if it means ruining their friendship.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: Whatcha Want
overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: CONTACT
overview: CONTACT is a short documentary film directed by Jonathan Walley that chronicles the transformation of an entire skatepark into a playable musical instrument—where the skate, BMX, art, and music scenes collide.  HCS has been many things: a skatepark, gallery, library, museum, and stage; but, for one weekend, Derek Nelson fabricator,  activist, BMX pro, and artist, transformed his skatepark into an immersive sonic installation—part instrument, part playground—for the community of Binghamton, NY to become co‑creators in a conflagration of sound. SMALL TOWN, BIG SOUND.  CONTACT reminds us of the joy in creativity, community, and the DIY spirit. Contact is about pushing boundaries, experimenting with art, and reclaiming space in an increasingly cruel, unkind, and oppressive world. It’s a poetic exploration of the creative process told by a filmmaker who calls HCS home.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: The Apple is Poison
overview: A man finds a mysterious yet threatening note in a bunch of apples.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: Place to Be
overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: The Spirit Lock
overview: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

title: Deep Dive
overview: After her family is murdered, a champion swimmer infiltrates the killer's home-ready to drown his world in vengeance.

title: Brown Sheep
overview: 16-year-old Jamila navigates adolescence and natural hair confidence whilst reminiscing her mother; and attending a predominantly white school.

title: The Cactus
overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

title: Final Transmissions
overview: Final Transmissions is an upcoming six-episode analog horror anthology series that features six short, found-footage films, set to be created using analog technology and VHS tapes to evoke a '90s television aesthetic.

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

title: The Ringing
overview: Jack suffers from relentless ringing in his ears that slowly isolates him from the world around him. As the noise grows unbearable and medical help fails, he takes a horrifying step to reclaim silence, with devastating consequences.

title: Delineations
overview: "Delineations" is an experimental short film highlighting Long Island, New York. Made using satellite images from Google Earth, the film explores nostalgia, growth, and confinement.

title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
original_title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
overview: An anthology film on the theme of fairy tales - some lighthearted, some more serious in tone, but all with a sprinkle of magic - and all set in the East of England county of Suffolk!

title: A Few Moments of Happiness
overview: A young woman watches the war in Lebanon through her phone, from her bed in Paris. Through digital images, family voices, and silences, the film explores the dissociation of a generation condemned to witness the destruction of the world from afar. An intimate essay on exile, screens, and the exhaustion of being a witness.

title: Against The Skin
overview: In a world driven by inherited beliefs, social noise, and quiet despair, a searching mind wrestles with the question of purpose, challenging whether humanity is truly living or simply surviving until it disappears.

title: Little Singer
overview: Amidst the horizons of Diné land, the legacy of historical trauma echos through generations. At the center, a medicine man and a small school, where grief and resilience meet in song, teaching, and k’é (kinship). Little Singer is rooted in land; carrying the vision and medicine of k’é forward.

title: Magpie
overview: Following the death of her mother, a young and talented pianist must find her way through monumental loss while preparing for an important audition. As grief and ambition begin to clash, Liz attempts to maintain a sense of normalcy while navigating the expectations from both herself and others. However, as she spirals through the stages of denial, anger, and devastation; she must come face-to-face with her loss and confront her grief through music.

title: Katô: Dreams of Dark Earth
overview: Katô follows the Munduruku through their decades-long struggle for land and clean water, revealing a world where daily survival is an act of resistance.  Refusing to wait for government recognition, the community has taken up the mantle of self-demarcation, putting their bodies on the line to map their own return. Supporting them is a women-led video collective that transforms cameras into visual arrows, documenting the destruction while affirming a vitality that cannot be extracted. By reclaiming the Katô—the ancestral Dark Earth—the Munduruku remind us that the soil is a living witness. Their fight for the land is not merely local; it is a desperate defense of the lungs of Mother Earth, upon which all life depends.

title: Hammer and Nail
overview: Ondřej Blažek, confronts the raw, untold emotions behind the fight. This UFC-inspired documentary takes you deep into the mind of a fighter, where each punch carries the weight of personal sacrifice, triumph, and inner demons. With high-octane energy and cinematic intensity, Coach Ondřej revisits pivotal moments from his career, reflecting on the emotional turmoil and adrenaline that fuel him. Watch as we recreate one of his most defining fights, immersing you in the brutal reality of what it means to fight, not just against your opponent—but against yourself.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
original_title: Clyde Saxophone in: The Lick of Death
overview: The Lick of Death follows Clyde Saxophone in another dastardly case. A new mysterious criminal has emerged and it’s up to Clyde Saxophone to stop them. Does he have what it takes to solve this enigma? Or will he get lost in the sauce?  Laugh, cry, vomit, and piss yourself just a little bit in this breakout classic from award-winning directors Dan Griffiths and Magnus Paulak

title: Across Timing
overview: Rachel, Hadrian, Stormi, and Julian are teenagers dealing with their own insecurities, desires, and fears while finding solace in conversations with a friend who watches them from behind a camera. Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: Through the Lens
overview: Nestled along the Great Eastern Highway in regional Western Australia stands The Big Camera — a museum housed inside a building shaped like a giant camera. What many mistake for a novelty roadside attraction is, in fact, one of the most significant private photography collections in the Southern Hemisphere.  This short documentary explores the life and legacy of The Big Camera Museum of Photography and its founder, Charles “Chic” Wadley, whose lifelong passion for capturing and preserving photographic history has created a one-of-a-kind cultural landmark.  Through personal interviews, archival imagery, cinematic visuals, and historical context, the film uncovers how this extraordinary museum came to exist, why it remains vital to regional heritage, and what it tells us about photography’s power to document human experience.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: Another
overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: Spider Island
overview: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: Build Me a Time Machine
overview: Young Woman longs for the innocent feeling of childhood and struggles with the thought of trying to live.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: Two high school theater kids, prone to playing elaborate tricks on their pals, pull off one last prank before graduation with grim consequences.

title: Willie and His Pigs
overview: Every 9 months, rural Kentucky-based regenerative farmer Willie Houston brings home a small group of piglets. He raises them, names them, cares for them, and has to say goodbye. This subtle portrait challenges assumptions of masculinity in farming and explores who bears the emotional weight of ethically raising animals.

title: Sandy
overview: As her childhood best friend prepares to depart for the US, a college student navigates her academic pursuits, strained family relationships, and a growing dread of the inevitable goodbye. ‘Sandy’ is a film about grief, memory, and how sometimes life forces you to bend into uncomfortable shapes as you go through it. Entirely self-funded and shot over two years in Davao City and Panabo City, it’s a love letter to the places and people we lose...or that lose us.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: In Bloom
overview: A witty intern resists her totalitarian society by igniting a government coup to protect her family.

title: Amityverse: End Game
overview: Third and final horror anthology in the Amityverse series, featuring 10 more Amityville-themed segments.

title: When the second sun arrives / A comet in your eyes
original_title: When the second sun arrives / A comet in your eyes
overview: Closing Janaina Wagner’s trilogy on the BR-230 Transamazonica Road phantasmagoria, When the second sun arrives / A comet in your eyes unfolds traversing a day when the Road stones, the remains of fallen comets and meteors, would depart back to the sky, countering cosmic time with everyday life along the highway.

title: Materia
overview: Brakhage-like animation with close-ups of rocks and fibers, and credits that describe them “in order of appearance.”

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Joshua
overview: A boy is trapped in his mothers basement. He has special powers.

title: The Pigeon
overview: A bereaved young woman believes her sister has been reincarnated, as a pigeon.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: It's All Fine
overview: A dad’s inner existential spiral detonates mid–preschool parent teacher conference.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: Abandoned
overview: Chasing a viral video to save their channel and friendship, two urban explorers break into a derelict facility scarred by sinister experiments. Trapped among its secrets, they enter a nightmare where history manifests as evil.

title: The State of Us
overview: Tearaway Frankie breaks out his best friend Taylor for one final night out. Over a riotous few hours filled with laughter, heartbreak and some home truths, the boys will face the ultimate test.

title: Mermaid Beach
overview: Two sisters move with their mother and stepdad to a new town by the sea. As they try to get used to their new home, they make a startling discovery that changes their lives forever.

title: RECORDING #27 - Short Film
overview: A young man records video diaries for therapy, trying to make sense of a past he can’t fully remember. But as he reviews the footage, he begins to notice something unsettling..  What starts as a quiet attempt at healing turns into a slow unraveling, as he realizes a presence has been with him far longer than he thought… and may have never left.

title: Sundown
overview: Three generations of women reunite in a remote cabin to avenge a loved one's death, only to discover their captive isn't who he seems to be, and his family is closing in, waiting for sundown.

title: Rocket Friendz
overview: In a world of mediocrity, Theo is a Rocket Friendz Battle Trainer with ONE goal: for he and his Rocket Friend Snout to BE THE BEST! He has been trying for 27 years!

title: Bodyhackers
overview: An environmental activist Denver Blake has decided to expose a cosmetics corporation that he believes is exploiting the insecurities caused by societal beauty standards. However, when he falls in love with Renée, a former ballerina obsessed with constantly improving her beauty, he becomes drawn into a mesmerizing underworld of plastic surgery.
